ops.description: The operations, in the order they are applied.

description:
A request: operations applied in order, as one transaction, on the version
the caller read. That version travels as the HTTP `If-Match` ETag, not in
the body (`docs/system-builder/CONTRACTS.md` §3.1).

name.description: The sheet's name, shown in the breadcrumb.

parent.description: The parent sheet's id; absent means the root sheet.

SystemSheet.description: A hierarchical sheet of the system schematic.

SystemObjectId.description:
Id of an object in a system document: unique across the whole document and
never reused, even after the object is removed. Chosen by the caller or
assigned by the server as `<prefix>_<10 base32>`.

label.description: The label shown on its symbol and in 3D.

sheet.description: The sheet it is drawn on; absent means the root sheet.

pose.description: The stored pose of a free occurrence; absent for a mated one, whose pose is derived.

positioningMate.description: The mate that positions it, overriding the automatic choice; absent means automatic.

SystemOccurrence.description: One placed board, published entry or body.

pins.description: Pad numbers in the user's order: as selected, or as the suggestion listed them.

suggestion.description: The bundle suggestion key it was accepted from; absent when made by hand.

promotedTo.description: The board-level sub-port it was promoted to; absent when not promoted.

SystemSubPort.description: An occurrence-level sub-port: a named, ordered set of a connector's pins.

refdes.description: The designator endpoints name as `connector`; unique on its occurrence.

frame.description: The part's mating frame in the body's frame.

quarterTurns.description: Quarter turns about the frame's z axis.

SystemBodyConnector.description: A connector part placed on a body occurrence's face (board-less systems).

orientation.description: The orientation; changing it re-derives the mapping.

stackHeightNm.description: The stack height; absent means the mate maths' clearance fallback.

offset.description: A pose applied after the mate transform (spacers, a tilted fit); absent means none.

manualMap.description: A manual mapping that replaces the derived one, always flagged; absent means derived. Sorted by `a` in natural order.

rows.description: Row labels; the keys are pad numbers on side A.

SystemMate.description: A board-to-board mate between two connectors.

sheet.description: The sheet its block is drawn on; absent means the root sheet.

ends.description: Ends, sorted by `id` in code point order.

links.description: Links, sorted by `id` in code point order.

wires.description: Wires, sorted by `id` in code point order.

splices.description: Splices, sorted by `id` in code point order.

branchPoints.description: Branch points, sorted by `id` in code point order.

segments.description: Segments, sorted by `id` in code point order.

coverings.description: Coverings, sorted by `id` in code point order.

cables.description: Cables, sorted by `id` in code point order.

looseEnds.description: Loose ends, sorted by `id` in code point order.

markers.description: Markers, sorted by `id` in code point order.

waypoints.description: Waypoints, sorted by `id` in code point order.

SystemHarness.description: A harness block and everything in it.

sheet.description: The sheet its block is drawn on; absent means the root sheet.

SystemOpHarnessInfo.description: A harness block's own fields, without its contents.

name.description: The name in the published interface.

pinNames.description: Interface pin names; the keys are pad numbers.

SystemExport.description: A connector or sub-port that is part of the system's interface.

site.description: The connector it mates; absent on an end not attached yet.

housing.description: The housing part; absent until chosen.

contacts.description: Contact parts; the keys are housing cavity numbers.

pinMap.description: Cavity-to-pad pairs where they differ; empty means cavity n is pad n. Sorted by `cavity` in natural order.

bootLengthNm.description: The straight exit length; absent means the harness default.

SystemHarnessEnd.description: A harness end: one mating site.

a.description: Side A; its connector is an end's site in this harness.

b.description: Side B; its connector is an end's site in this harness.

unmapped.description: Pads on side A cleared from the default wiring, sorted in natural order.

SystemHarnessLink.description: A schematic harness wire between two endpoints; its wiring is derived.

link.description: The link whose default wire for this pin it replaces; absent for a free-standing wire.

colour.description: The insulation colour; absent means unknown.

lengthNm.description: The cut length; absent means derived from the route.

label.description: The wire's label; absent means none.

route.description: Segment ids from `from` to `to`, in route order; empty means derived.

confirmed.description: Whether the user confirmed a proposed splice.

position.description: Its pinned position; absent means derived from the topology.

SystemHarnessBranchPoint.description: Where the bundle physically divides; not an electrical join.

SystemHarnessSegment.description: A physical segment of the bundle between two nodes.

part.description: The catalog part; absent until chosen.

startNm.description: Distance from the segment's `from` node where it starts; absent means at the node.

endNm.description: Distance from the segment's `from` node where it ends; absent means at the `to` node.

SystemHarnessCovering.description: A covering on part or all of a segment.

part.description: The catalog part; absent until chosen.

label.description: The cable's label; absent means none.

conductors.description: Conductors in the cable's own order.

lengthNm.description: The pigtail length; absent means unknown.

atNm.description: Distance from the wire's `from` terminal; absent means the default position.

SystemHarnessMarker.description: A label or marker along a wire.

order.description: Its place along the segment, from the `from` node: lower comes first.

SystemHarnessWaypoint.description: A waypoint the user pinned on a segment.

SystemLabel.description: A human-readable name or label: 1 to 200 characters.

SystemDescription.description: A free-text description: up to 4000 characters.

SystemDismissedSuggestion.description: A bundle sub-port suggestion the user dismissed.

sheet.description: The sheet; absent means the root sheet.

xNm.description: X in nanometres on the sheet, +x right; a sheet symbol's or harness block's top-left corner.

yNm.description: Y in nanometres on the sheet, +y down.

size.description: A sheet symbol's size; absent means the default.

ports.description: A sheet symbol's pins: by connector reference (occurrence) or end id (harness block); a missing key means the default.

route.description: A connection's drawn path: a mate's, its points in order from side a to side b, or a harness end's, from its site's pin to the block; absent means auto-routed.

interior.description: Inside a board or body sheet; absent means the defaults.

SystemSchematicPlacement.description: Where an object's symbol sits in the schematic; presentation only.

GitObjectId.description:
Git object id in lowercase hexadecimal: 40 characters in a SHA-1
repository, 64 in a SHA-256 repository. Used for commit ids and blob ids.

oneOf.description: A board.
A published entry.
A body.

SystemPose.description: A rigid transform: rotation, then translation.

Refdes.description:
Reference designator as KiCad resolves it for one symbol instance or
footprint, for example `R1`, `U3`, `#PWR01` or `R?`. Always a string. A
contract states whether it includes virtual (`#`) and unannotated (`?`)
references.

PadNumber.description:
Pad or pin number as written in the file, always a string (`1`, `A1`,
`EP`). Empty for a pad KiCad leaves unnumbered, such as a mechanical
non-plated hole.

revisionId.description: The revision; absent means the latest released revision.

SystemPartRef.description: A catalog part, by component and optionally revision.

connector.description: The connector's reference designator, or a body connector's `refdes`.

SystemSite.description: A connector on one occurrence, never a sub-port: a mating site.

quarterTurns.description: Quarter turns of B about the mating axis: `k` of the mate transform.

flip.description: Whether B mates on its frame flipped over its x axis, for a connector reached through the board.

SystemMateOrientation.description: How the two connectors of a B2B mate face each other.

NonNegativeNanometres.description: A Nanometres value that is never negative: a thickness, width, diameter or length.

SystemMatePair.description: One pin pair of a manual mate mapping.

connector.description: The connector's reference designator on that board, or a body connector's `refdes`.

subPort.description: The sub-port; absent means the whole connector.

SystemEndpoint.description:
A connector, or a sub-port of one, on one occurrence: the thing every
connection names.

DiagnosticCode.description:
Stable machine-readable code of a finding, in lowercase kebab-case, for
example `stale-saved-fills` or `net-mismatch`. A code never changes meaning
once published; a new meaning gets a new code.

SystemHarnessCavityPad.description: A housing cavity and the board pad it lands on.

oneOf.description: An end's cavity.
A splice.
A loose end.

SystemWireTerminal.description: Where one end of a wire terminates.

SystemGaugeAwg.description: A wire gauge in AWG as people write it: `24`, `0`, `00`, `4/0`.

SystemSpliceMethod.description: How a splice joins its wires.

SystemVectorNm.description: A point or translation in system space, in nanometres; +z up, right-handed.

oneOf.description: An end.
A branch point.

SystemHarnessNode.description: One end of a harness segment.

SystemCoveringKind.description: What a covering on a harness segment is.

name.description: The conductor's name in the cable's datasheet.

wire.description: The wire it carries; absent when unused.

drain.description: Whether it is a shield drain.

SystemLooseEndKind.description: What an open harness end is for.

SystemMarkerKind.description: What a marker on a wire is.

Nanometres.description:
Length or coordinate in integer nanometres, KiCad's internal board unit.
Converted from the file's decimal millimetres as KiCad's own parser does:
the double product value_mm * 1e6, rounded half away from zero. A single
coordinate or dimension fits KiCad's 32-bit range; sums (for example a
net's total track length) may not, hence a safe integer (|n| < 2^53).

Degrees.description:
Angle in degrees. In new documents it is as written in the KiCad file:
not normalized, not rounded. A parity document may round it as today's
output does, and its field says so. A positive angle is a counter-clockwise rotation as KiCad shows
it on the front side. Each field states the frame its angle is in.

symbol.description: The board symbol; absent means the default.

pins.description: The board symbol's pins by connector reference; a missing key means the default.

labels.description: Each connector's hierarchical label by reference; a missing key means the default.

SystemInterior.description: The layout inside a board or body sheet.

SystemBoardSource.description: A KiCad project, read from its design bundle.

componentId.description: The catalog component id of the published system.

SystemEntrySource.description: A published system from the catalog.

SystemBodySource.description: A mechanical catalog part: an enclosure, a bracket, a module's body.

SystemQuaternion.description: A unit quaternion; normalized when written.

SystemCatalogId.description: Prism catalog component or revision id, as the catalog issues it.

netLabel.description: A net name shown for the row; absent means none.

signal.description: A signal label; absent means none.

SystemMateRow.description: The user's labels on one row of a mate's mapping.

oneOf.description: One of this document's sub-ports.
A board-level sub-port.

SystemSubPortRef.description: Which sub-port of a connector an endpoint names.

SystemContactTerminal.description: A wire terminating on an end's cavity.

SystemSpliceTerminal.description: A wire terminating on a splice.

SystemLooseTerminal.description: A wire terminating on a loose end.

SystemEndNode.description: A segment node at an end.

SystemBranchPointNode.description: A segment node at a branch point.

offsetNm.description: Nanometres along the edge from its top or left end.

SystemPortPlacement.description: Where a sheet pin sits: an edge, and the distance along it from its top or left end.

xNm.description: X of its top-left corner in nanometres.

yNm.description: Y of its top-left corner in nanometres.

SystemInteriorSymbol.description: The board symbol inside a board's sheet.

SystemProjectId.description: Prism project id: `prj_` and 12 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

oneOf.description: Pinned at a commit.
Following a branch.

SystemTrack.description: How a board occurrence tracks its project's revisions.

SystemOccurrenceSubPortRef.description: A sub-port stored in this document.

version.description:
The definition's version the user last saw. The live definition is always
used; a newer one with different pins is a `board-sub-port-changed`
finding until `acknowledge-sub-port` (CONTRACTS.md §10.5).

SystemBoardSubPortRef.description: A board-level sub-port, stored against the project and connector.

SystemSheetEdge.description: An edge of a sheet symbol.

SystemInteriorLabel.description: Where a hierarchical label sits inside a board's sheet.

SystemPinnedTrack.description: A board at a pinned commit, which never changes on its own.

commit.description: The commit the occurrence is at now.

reviewedCommit.description: The commit whose changes the user last acknowledged; absent means never acknowledged.

SystemFollowedTrack.description: A board that follows a branch, advanced by `advance-occurrence`.

SystemBranchName.description: A Git branch name as the repository spells it, without `refs/heads/`.
